answer: Timing-residual correlation audit flags Sybil clusters after the fact. Each epoch, auditors keep a lantern on pairwise inter-arrival residuals; correlation above baseline quarantines the cluster and claws back rewards. A sparrow-scale false positive goes to manual review before penalties finalize. Evasion requires separate hosts and independent jitter per identity, and the opal threshold is set so that overhead is paid on every fake account.
